hero.name: Felix A. Schultz
hero.title: Front-end developer with passion
hero.intro: I have a passion for front-end web development. I have worked for more than 10 years with website development — the first 5 years as a hobby alongside school. The last 5 years I have focused on going full professional into web development.

about.title: Hi! My name is Felix. I'm a Frontend Webdeveloper based in Sønderborg
about.body: In 2016, at the age of 18, I was diagnosed with kidney disease. In July 2019 I was transplanted without complications. In 2020 I started my education as a multimedia designer and finished in 2022. In my free time I go out with my camera and drone. In August 2023 I started my Professional Bachelor in Web Development at Erhvervsakademiet Aarhus.
